description.text: A Quick Construction Pack, Type Unit: Lightning, released on 16 January 2005: a fixed pack of 15 cards built around Lightning Pokémon, led by Raichu ex, with a coin and a rules sheet. Two packs make a half deck and four make a 60-card deck; the six packs, one for each type, came out together.
